categories.main_business_segments: SG Corporation operates primarily in three business segments: garment export, fashion business, and others (mainly real estate rental). The garment export segment produces and supplies women's wear, casual wear, and children's clothing mainly to large US buyers like GAP and Macy's under OEM. The fashion business segment owns five brands including men's suits (BASSO), women's wear (ab.f.z, ab.plus), and luxury leather goods (COLOMBO), selling through department stores, outlets, and agencies. The other segment generates rental income from real estate holdings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses OEM manufacturing for garment exports, producing woven garments such as jackets, pants, and coats primarily in Vietnam through its subsidiary SSV and partner factories. The luxury leather goods segment emphasizes artisanal craftsmanship with Italian artisans performing hand-made production, preserving traditional techniques. The design research institute conducts seasonal trend analysis, quality control, and sewing technology R&D to support product planning and development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major US retail buyers such as GAP Group and Macy's for the garment export segment. The fashion business targets domestic consumers through department stores, outlets, and direct retail channels across South Korea. The luxury leather goods are sold mainly in high-end department store import and luxury sections. The geographic market focus is primarily North America for exports and South Korea for domestic fashion sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in Vietnam (SSV, HCMC) and Italy (CVDS), with sales concentrated in the United States (export buyers) and South Korea (domestic fashion market). It also has subsidiaries and joint ventures in Japan and the USA related to the COLOMBO brand. The headquarters is located in Seoul, South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: SG Corporation functions as a midstream manufacturer and downstream retailer. It manages production through its overseas subsidiaries and partner factories, supplying finished garments to large retail buyers under OEM. It also operates retail and wholesale distribution channels domestically for its fashion brands and luxury leather goods, integrating design, manufacturing, and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on design innovation through its in-house design research institute, which conducts trend forecasting, quality control, and sewing technology development. It aims to enhance production efficiency and cost competitiveness by expanding production capacity and diversifying sourcing, especially in Southeast Asia. The luxury segment emphasizes preserving artisanal craftsmanship and brand value through continuous design development and trademark registration. The company is also exploring business diversification into financial consulting, golf-related businesses, and other sectors, though these are not yet operational.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales: OEM garment exports to large US buyers and retail sales of fashion and luxury leather goods in domestic channels. The company also earns rental income from real estate holdings. The export segment operates on order-based OEM contracts, while the fashion segment sells branded products through department stores, outlets, and direct retail. Financial investments and other diversified business activities contribute marginally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the garment export OEM market, SG Corporation competes with numerous global vendors, leveraging strengths in quality, delivery reliability, and cost efficiency. In the domestic fashion and luxury leather goods market, it competes with other established Korean and international brands, emphasizing brand loyalty, design innovation, and artisanal quality. The company maintains a competitive edge through integrated global production management and diversified sales channels but faces intense competition in both segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 143 billion KRW, with a decline of 11.3% from the previous year due to challenging market conditions. The company has total assets of about 303.5 billion KRW and equity of 242.8 billion KRW, maintaining a strong equity ratio of 80%. Despite a net loss in 2023, the company sustained operating profits in its core segments through cost control and efficiency improvements. The business has shown a stable but slightly contracting revenue trend amid global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SG Corporation differentiates itself by combining global manufacturing capabilities with strong design and quality control, delivering reliable OEM garment production to major US buyers. Its fashion brands offer diverse, trend-responsive apparel with broad domestic distribution, while the COLOMBO luxury leather goods brand emphasizes artisanal craftsmanship and heritage, appealing to high-end consumers. The company’s value lies in its integrated supply chain, design expertise, and ability to maintain quality and delivery standards in competitive markets.
